items.title: AI Funding Multiples vs AI Acquisition Multiples | FE International
items.snippet: Neither one is wrong, by the way, and neither is the real one. If you know which...
items.raw_snippet:
Neither one is wrong, by the way, and neither is the real one. If you know which question each was built to answer, you walk into a process with expectations that survive contact with a term sheet. If you don't, the first indication tends to land badly.

### The short answer

A funding round prices the newest shares. A buyer prices the business. Most of what follows is just that sentence, unpacked. [...] For planning an exit, the one derived from comparable completed transactions, adjusted for your own metrics. Funding multiples are useful for thinking about a next round and much less useful for thinking about a sale, since nobody has ever paid one for a whole company. A business valuation that works from your actual numbers is the more reliable starting point.

### How long does it take to close the gap between the two? [...] The two numbers measure different things

### What a funding multiple is actually pricing

Carta's cap-table data puts the point better than any argument could. In the first quarter of 2026, the median primary pre-money valuation at Series A sat near $300m for AI foundational model companies and near $55m for everything else. Same round label, same quarter, roughly five times the number.

items.snippet: Now hold that against what Anthropic just filed. More than 90 pages of the prosp...
items.raw_snippet:
Now hold that against what Anthropic just filed. More than 90 pages of the prospectus cover risk disclosures. The company tells investors in writing that AI could pose catastrophic or existential risks, and that its models can show self-preserving behavior, resist shutdown, conceal or manipulate information, and act in ways that resemble blackmail. It is seeking a valuation of up to two trillion dollars on that document. [...] Let’s begin with the technology. Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora said Nvidia could not promise him chips for 2028, illustrating how constrained some future capacity remains. Anthropic’s IPO filing this week showed a company earning $2.08 in revenue for every dollar of compute, up from 40 cents eighteen months ago. Demand for intelligence is not the problem. We are seeing that in the numbers.

Financing is a different story. [...] I’m not a doomer. I think AI is one of the most important technologies we have ever created, and it will accelerate our flourishing. But there will be challenges, and the financing is where this one shows up first.

The technology will be fine. The ownership might be changing hands.

Peter

[...] We are a team of 2,200 technology experts designing the software, products, cloud, and AI that power L'Oréal in 150 countries. We build tools that help our internal teams work smarter, while shaping immersive digital experiences for millions of consumers. With Gen-AI unlocking new possibilities, we combine advanced science with cutting-edge technology to deliver beauty that is personalized, inclusive, and responsible.   
 This is engineering excellence, delivered at global scale [...] You get the budget and data to build things that actually ship - like L'Oréal GPT or our connected beauty devices-and push them live across 150 countries. We move fast, but we don't do it blindly.
